## Case format
```json
{ "case_id": "PUB-01", "today": "2026-08-31",
  "areas": ["Tejgaon", "Motijheel", "Mirpur"],
  "travel_minutes": {"Tejgaon": {"Tejgaon": 0, "Motijheel": 15, "Mirpur": 60}, ...},
  "technicians": [ {"id": "T01", "name": "Rafiq", "skills": ["ac"], "shift_start": "09:00", "shift_end": "18:00", "home_area": "Motijheel"}, ... ],
  "jobs": [ {"id": "J01", "area": "Mirpur", "skill": "electrical", "duration_minutes": 60, "window_start": "09:00", "window_end": "12:00"}, ... ],
  "manual_move": {"job_id": "J02", "to_technician": "T01"} }
```
Times are `HH:MM` on `today`. The travel table is authoritative and symmetric; no return home is required.
`manual_move` is the scripted move for AT4.
